NFL DFS Projections Week 4: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 11 · 7 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 5, 11:08 AM ET

Jaxon Smith-Njigba carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 4 DraftKings main slate: 21.5 DraftKings points at $8,800. He holds 18% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 100,000 simulations. Jonathan Taylor holds the largest share at 30% for $7,800.

Behind Smith-Njigba, the model's next four projections are Christian McCaffrey (21.4, $8,200), Jonathan Taylor (21.3, $7,800), Brock Purdy (19.3, $6,500) and Jaylen Warren (18.8, $6,700). Brock Purdy returns the most per dollar of that group at 2.97 projected points per $1,000. Jaxon Smith-Njigba leads the wide receivers at 21.5 for $8,800, Brock Purdy leads the quarterbacks at 19.3 for $6,500, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 17.1 for $6,700.

The 7-game slate runs from a 48.5-point total in DEN at SF down to 38.5 in MIA at MIN. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 5, 11:08 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 100,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 4 DraftKings projections

Brock Purdy, SF vs DEN ($6,500)

Brock Purdy carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 19.3 DraftKings points at $6,500, the 4th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.6 points clear of Jayden Daniels. The model includes 4.0 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.97 projected points per $1,000, 10th of 11 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Purdy averaged 19.3 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 36.4, and he holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 3-point favorite at home against Denver, with an implied team total of 25.75 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Jayden Daniels, WAS vs IND ($6,000)

Jayden Daniels projects 2nd at the position with 18.8 DraftKings points at $6,000. The model includes 6.4 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.13 projected points per $1,000, 8th of 11 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Daniels averaged 18.8 points with a simulated floor of 7.0 and a ceiling of 33.8, and he holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Washington is a 4.5-point underdog at home against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 21 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Value: Tyson Bagent, CHI vs NYJ ($4,700)

Tyson Bagent projects for 17.8 DraftKings points at $4,700, which works out to 3.79 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 11 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 5.7 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Bagent averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 7.0 and a ceiling of 32.8, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Chicago is a 3.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 43.5.
